summary: Intermap Technologies filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 7, 2026 press release announcing completion of its acquisition of PCI Geomatics Group Inc. (operating as CATALYST). No purchase price, share consideration, premium, or financing terms were disclosed. PCI adds over 30,000 installed licenses across 150+ countries and is expected to double Intermap's recurring revenue. Management introduced 2027 commercial revenue guidance of $12–15 million (+100% growth) with 50%+ contribution margins. The transaction accelerates Intermap's roadmap into distributed edge processing and microservices. Watch for forthcoming deal economics, integration milestones, and whether recurring revenue synergies materialize as guided.
